description: This file defines the AOTICallDelegate class acting as a higher-order operator for calling AOTInductor lowered modules in PyTorch. It includes implementations for different dispatch modes such as ProxyTorchDispatchMode, FakeTensorMode, and a functionalize variant, handling tensor argument processing and module invocation.

classes.name: AOTICallDelegate
classes.description: A higher-order operator class for facilitating calls to AOTInductor lowered modules within exported PyTorch graphs.
